stories.title: L’Islande, ce pays sans armée, au cœur de l’OTAN, qui doit repenser ses liens avec les Etats-Unis

en.title: Iceland, this country without an army, at the heart of NATO, must rethink its ties with the United States
en.summary: Iceland, a NATO founding member without a military, relies on the Atlantic Alliance and a 1951 bilateral defense treaty with the United States for security. Donald Trump's provocations and Arctic geopolitical tensions are complicating this arrangement.

stories.title: Formel 1: GP von Spanien – Norris mit Malheur – Antonelli fährt zum 8. Saisonsieg

en.title: Formula 1: Spanish GP – Norris with trouble – Antonelli drives to 8th season victory
en.summary: Kimi Antonelli won the Spanish Grand Prix in Madrid. He benefited from a McLaren team error.

stories.title: La Commune de Crans-Montana licencie un employé dans une affaire d’usurpation d’identité sur un projet du Constellation

en.title: The Municipality of Crans-Montana fires an employee in an identity usurpation case related to the Constellation project
en.summary: A municipal employee accused of identity usurpation and already charged in the Constellation fire was immediately dismissed. He allegedly used a colleague's name on a terrace project without permission.

stories.title: LIVE-TICKER - Krieg in der Ukraine: Polen alarmiert nach Angriff auf Zug im ukrainisch-polnischen Grenzgebiet +++ Entwarnung in Litauen: Vermeintliche Drohnensichtung entpuppt sich als Vogelschwarm

en.title: LIVE TICKER - War in Ukraine: Poland on alert after train attack in Ukrainian-Polish border area +++ All-clear in Lithuania: Alleged drone sighting turns out to be bird flock
en.summary: Poland responded to an attack on a train near the Ukrainian-Polish border, while Lithuania issued an all-clear after determining a suspected drone sighting was actually a flock of birds. Russia's ongoing war in Ukraine continues.

stories.title: Die Siegesserie ist perfekt: Die 800-Meter-Läuferin Audrey Werro krönt ihr Traumjahr an der Ultimate Championship

en.title: The winning streak is perfect: 800-meter runner Audrey Werro crowns her dream year at the Ultimate Championship
en.summary: The 22-year-old Swiss athlete won her final race of the season, completing an impressive winning streak and highlighting a consistently strong year for Swiss track and field.

stories.title: Krieg in der Ukraine – Polen alarmiert nach Angriff auf Zug von Kiew nach Warschau

en.title: War in Ukraine – Poland alarmed after attack on train from Kyiv to Warsaw
en.summary: The locomotive of a passenger train traveling between Kyiv and Warsaw was attacked at the border station of Jahodyn on Sunday, prompting Polish concern.

stories.title: Erstes Paris-Konzert – Emotionaler Auftakt: Céline Dion begeistert die Fans

en.title: First Paris concert – Emotional beginning: Céline Dion delights fans
en.summary: Céline Dion performed the opening concert of her Paris series, generating enthusiasm among attendees.

stories.title: 250 bovins périssent dans un incendie à Palézieux

en.title: 250 cattle die in farm fire at Palézieux
en.summary: A fire at a farm in Palézieux destroyed a barn and killed or led to the euthanasia of approximately 250 animals, mainly calves. No human injuries were reported.

stories.title: Audrey Werro wins inaugural Ultimate Championship 800m title

en.title: Audrey Werro wins inaugural Ultimate Championship 800m title
en.summary: Swiss runner Audrey Werro won the first Ultimate Championship 800-metre race in Budapest with a time of 1:55.88, earning $150,000 in prize money and extending her unbeaten outdoor season streak.

stories.title: Des centaines de bovins tués dans l'incendie d'une grande ferme à Palézieux

en.title: Hundreds of cattle killed in fire at large farm in Palézieux
en.summary: A fire broke out at a farm in Palézieux on Saturday evening, resulting in the death of 250 animals. No human injuries were reported, and the fire was controlled by Sunday morning.

stories.title: LIVE-TICKER - Iran-Krieg: Toter nach Angriff auf iranisches Containerschiff

en.title: LIVE TICKER - Iran War: Death Following Attack on Iranian Container Ship
en.summary: The United States and Iran have been in a state of war since February 2026. Although a ceasefire was agreed, Donald Trump declared it ended in early July. This ticker covers the latest developments.

stories.title: Céline Dion renaît sur scène près de Paris après six ans d'absence

en.title: Céline Dion Returns to Stage Near Paris After Six Years Away
en.summary: Céline Dion performed near Paris on Saturday after a six-year absence from the stage, marking the beginning of a concert series. The comeback follows years impacted by illness.

stories.title: Trumps «Vizekönig» stösst in Südamerika an seine Grenzen

en.title: Trump's "Viceroy" Reaches Limits in South America
en.summary: Marco Rubio visited new U.S. allies in South America for the first time. However, Colombia, Ecuador, and Peru are not fully following Washington's lead.

stories.title: INTERVIEW - Die neuen Herren der Finanzmärkte: «KI-Agenten können die Notenbanken in die Enge treiben», sagt der Princeton-Professor Markus Brunnermeier

en.title: INTERVIEW - The new masters of financial markets: "AI agents can corner central banks," says Princeton professor Markus Brunnermeier
en.summary: Autonomous AI systems are gaining power in financial markets, but their decision-making processes remain opaque. Economist Markus Brunnermeier warns this opacity poses risks to financial stability.

stories.title: Er wirkte blass und distanziert. Trotzdem hatte der neue Apple-Chef John Ternus einen guten ersten Auftritt

en.title: He appeared pale and distant. Still, new Apple CEO John Ternus had a good first appearance
en.summary: John Ternus, known for Apple's high-margin hardware, made his debut as CEO by presenting a foldable iPhone, marking a successful first public appearance despite his reserved demeanor.

stories.title: Die Spekulanten werden die Entschlossenheit von US-Finanzminister Scott Bessent testen

en.title: Speculators will test the resolve of US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent
en.summary: Former hedge fund manager Scott Bessent challenged investors this week to bet against his market interventions, a stance that could lead to significant consequences.

stories.title: Bitcoin feiert ein Comeback – oder handelt es sich bloss um ein Strohfeuer?

en.title: Bitcoin celebrates a comeback – or is it just a flash in the pan?
en.summary: Bitcoin's price has risen sharply in a short period, with analysts considering two very different scenarios for what may happen next.
